# Sortie feedback, 2026-11-23 — LV-0 instruments card

Branch flown: `feature/bl16-lift-vector-law` @ 38f22896 plus the `/command/flight` epoch fix
(982b1a80). Card: `docs/acceptance/2026-11-23-bl16-lv0-card.md`. User's words verbatim; status-line
samples kept as pasted (columns: t, fc_mode, a_f, a_r, a_u, v_g, v_g_f, phi_dot, theta_dot,
psi_dot, ball).

## Before the fix

> on command "you have controls"
> `aircraft_client.AircraftLayerError: request to http://<collector>:7791/command/flight failed: HTTP Error 400: Bad Request`
> Unable, not ready.

Cause: `/command/flight` bounded `epoch` at 2**31−1; body-layer's epoch is wall-clock ms. Fixed
in 982b1a80.

## A — Voice take retest

> control again.
> How bad erratic takeover is depends on the initial attitude, but it's bad.
> Both off -> Mode 1 and Mode 2 -> Mode 1.
